svg.title: Tech stack
svg.desc: An animated orbit of technologies around a React hub with JavaScript and TypeScript moons, plus Node.js, HTML5, CSS3, Angular, Next.js, Redux, Tailwind CSS, Git and GitHub. Below, chips grouped by Frontend, Motion and 3D, Data, AI and Tools, and Backend, Platforms and Testing.
